compiler.boundedChange: Existing typed obj.ts data projector accepts signed finite numeric literals; no executable expression evaluation

artifacts.sourceFingerprintStrategy: quick-v1: length + UTC mtime ticks + up to 64KiB each at beginning/middle/end; not full-content proof
artifacts.publication: checksum, bounded temp stream, cross-process file lease, flush, atomic rename, abandoned-temp cleanup

performance.cancellationFixture: six-second stereo PCM/MKV, 1 ms energy windows; native job cancellation
performance.measurementScope: Observed bounded fixtures, not performance guarantees. CLI includes startup. Process working-set peak sampled at 10 ms. Native frame timings include UI preparation and GPU submission.

headlessDemonstration.sourceCharacteristics: 160x90/30 H.264 numbered frames, hard visual cut at 3s, stereo anti-phase 440Hz/known silence [2,4), independent mono 880Hz; Matroska PCM 48kHz

exactTiming.coordinates: native rational PTS + exact source sample offsets; half-open intervals; checked sequence conversion
exactTiming.removalRounding: start up / end down to sequence frame

knownDiagnostics: FFmpeg 7.1 emits Matroska keyframe-index diagnostics on some existing native random seeks of the generated PCM/MKV fixture; stderr retained; independently decoded frame IDs/audio/duration/codecs pass.
limitations: Mono/stereo analysis only; no automatic OBS stream mixing
Aligned, unlocked, ordered single-source rough cuts only; unsafe unrelated tracks/discontinuous audio rejected
Waveform base coarsens at 65536 bins; activity/scene budgets 65536 records; atomic plan budget 500 operations
Quick sampled fingerprint can miss unsampled edits with preserved size/mtime
Existing coarse-clock random seeks are not sample-exact; PCM compared within 1 ms native clock quantum
No multi-hour OBS/physical acoustic sync/heavy-4K qualification
Native smoke invokes actual handlers and GPU readback; no separate physical mouse/dialog replay
No semantic scenes/speech/highlight model or new scripting runtime
